research_updates.title: Project boundary, ownership and operating chronology audit
research_updates.notes: SEC filings from 2017 and 2025, Johnson County parcel records, City planning materials and FCC records were reconciled by 24400 West Valley Parkway, the State Farm Data Center name, SFDC Cedar Creek, quick reference R662349 and tax ID DP69210000 0001. They establish a single approximately 20-acre property built in 2016, State Farm possession by early 2017, later HMC Data Center 2 LLC parcel ownership and continuing State Farm tenancy. Financing borrowers, parcel owners and operator are not conflated, and no neighboring U.S. Bank facility or wider two-property State Farm portfolio amount is assigned here.

source.title: Citigroup Commercial Mortgage Trust 2017-C4 Free Writing Prospectus
source.notes: The filed term sheet identifies a 193,953-square-foot data center on 20.1 acres in Olathe, constructed in 2016 as a State Farm build-to-suit. It reports 60,515 square feet of raised floor, 6,660 kW critical IT load, 100% State Farm occupancy, lease commencement in November 2016 and tenant possession and use. Loan, purchase-price, rent and appraisal figures are financing or valuation measures and are not normalized as local economic contributions.

research_updates.title: Construction and permit-value audit
research_updates.notes: City annual permit reports, planning files and indexed permit histories were searched for 2015-2026 by BC15-0148, BC17-0041, SFDC Cedar Creek, State Farm, Kansas City Data Center and the exact address. Official reports support separate $81,555,000 new-construction and $28,000,000 tenant-finish permit values. These administrative values are neither verified expenditures nor safely additive to each other or the SEC's $169,778,850 estimated cumulative capital figure; no worker hours, construction payroll, schedule, equipment split or realized construction job count was found.

source.title: City of Olathe 2015 Year in Review — fourth-quarter nonresidential permits

research_updates.title: State and local incentive audit — no project award amount located
research_updates.notes: Kansas Commerce's current explorer and legacy HPIP table, PEAK/HPIP program pages, Kansas Revenue tax-expenditure reports for 2009-2024, Olathe budgets/ACFRs and Legistar agendas, and indexed IRB/TIF/bond records were searched using State Farm, Kansas City Data Center, JDM III SF Kansas City DC, HMC Data Center 2, R662349, DP69210000 0001 and 24400 West Valley Parkway. The legacy table directly reports HPIP participation, Benchmark 1 achieved and $282,100,000 in its FY2020 Total Capital Investment field, but leaves Amount Offered, Amount Claimed and jobs blank or n/a; later exact-address FY2022/FY2023 rows show zero capital investment and do not disclose a benefit. No executed agreement, paid or claimed credit, local abatement schedule, bond subsidy or counterfactual tax amount was located.

source.title: Kansas Department of Commerce Transparency Explorer
source.notes: The current Transparency Explorer and program indexes were searched for State Farm, Kansas City Data Center, JDM III SF Kansas City DC, HMC Data Center 2, 24400 West Valley Parkway, PEAK and HPIP. research_updates.title: Corrective last-resort model-candidate decision table
research_updates.notes: Candidate decisions after the direct-source gap-closure pass: (1) suppliers — a permit/HPIP/SEC capital-times-local-share or input-output model is rejected because construction-only paid spend, vendor geography, a Johnson County local-purchase share and proof against overlap among the three capital measures are missing; (2) community — an enterprise-giving-per-floor-area, per-employee or local-agent allocation is rejected because no facility transfer numerator, facility employment denominator, recipient attribution or non-overlap identity exists; (3) public costs — the exact 2025 parcel-tax-payment identity is retained only as a same-account annual marginal-service-cost break-even threshold, not actual cost or net fiscal position; (4) HPIP credit or net-fiscal counterfactual — 10% times the FY2020 capital field is rejected because the table leaves offered and claimed amounts blank and does not establish the credit-eligible basis, tax liability, utilization, carryforward timing, recipient or non-overlap with parcel taxes; (5) county GDP — a 2008-2015 inverse-distance benchmark is retained as a descriptive 2024 gap with fit sensitivity and no causal attribution; (6) county employment — the same bounded descriptive design is retained, but it is not facility FTE; (7) county wage — the same bounded descriptive design is retained for nominal average weekly wage, not facility pay. Supplier and community gaps remain open rather than zero.

source.title: Kansas Commerce legacy HPIP transparency table — State Farm Olathe entries
source.notes: The table defines HPIP as a 10% tax credit program for qualifying above-average-wage employers and labels its columns, including Amount Offered, Amount Claimed, jobs and Total Capital Investment. Exact-address rows for State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company show FY2020 Total Capital Investment of $282,100,000 with Benchmark 1 achieved; the duplicate FY2020 display is treated as one observation. FY2022 and FY2023 rows display zero capital investment, and all displayed State Farm rows leave offered, claimed and job fields blank or n/a. The table supports participation and the reported FY2020 investment field, not a claimed credit, paid incentive, annual spending series, realized job count or amount safely additive to other capital measures.

research_updates.title: Electricity, utility and resource-consumption audit
research_updates.notes: KCC current and archived docket indexes, SPP planning tables, Olathe utility billing pages, SEC facility descriptions, State Farm's 2023 Impact Report and indexed Evergy/KCPL materials were searched for 2015-2026 using State Farm, 24400 West Valley Parkway, owner entities, tariff, special contract, load, electricity, water, wastewater, PUE, renewable, Olathe-Switzer and NTC 210495. SEC filings support only 6.66 MW and 7.5 MW critical-IT-load capacity snapshots. The SPP table identifies a $706,018.74 regional-reliability Olathe-Switzer terminal upgrade placed in service in 2019 but contains no State Farm, address or customer link. No primary site record identifies the serving utility, special contract, observed demand, annual kWh, power bill, measured PUE, metered water, wastewater volume, rate class or account payment; capacity and the regional project are not allocated to consumption or facility cost.

research_updates.notes: SPP Regional State Committee project tables were searched for 2014-2026 by Olathe, Switzer, State Farm, 24400 West Valley Parkway, SFDC Cedar Creek, Kansas City Data Center, KCPL and Evergy. source.notes: The regional project table lists NTC 210495 / PID 51294 / UID 72049, the KCPL Olathe-Switzer 161 kV Circuit 1 terminal upgrade, as a 2018 ITPNT regional-reliability project with a final cost of $706,018.74 and a November 26, 2019 in-service date. research_updates.title: Environmental, generator and emergency-response audit
research_updates.notes: FCC earth-station grants, the MARC Regional Hazardous Materials Emergency Preparedness Plan, EPA ECHO, KDHE air/public-notice pages, KEIMS and SLEIS were searched using State Farm Insurance Data Center, 24400 West Valley Parkway, E181424, generator, diesel, fuel, sulfuric acid, air, stormwater and discharge. The FCC grant documents communications equipment; the MARC EHS table identifies the exact-address site and reports a 35,401-pound maximum daily sulfuric-acid inventory. The inventory is neither annual use nor economic cost, and no opened record supplies generator count, fuel storage, run hours, emissions, discharge, incident cost or attributable emergency-response expense. A 2016 Phase I statement in the SEC filing is due diligence, not operating performance.

source.notes: The regional emergency-planning material identifies the State Farm Insurance Data Center at 24400 W Valley Parkway and its extremely-hazardous-substance table reports a maximum daily amount of 35,401 pounds of sulfuric acid. research_updates.title: Operations and workforce audit — facility capacity found, labor totals absent
research_updates.notes: SEC filings, State Farm careers and 2023 Impact Report, Kansas Commerce HPIP tables, Olathe economic-development/planning records and indexed job results were searched for 2015-2026 using Olathe, 24400 West Valley Parkway, data center, employee, contractor, technician, facilities, wage, payroll, residency and apprenticeship. research_updates.title: Planning, expansion and strategic-infrastructure audit
research_updates.notes: City planning, zoning, annual development reports, Legistar packets, transportation and infrastructure references were searched by address, SFDC Cedar Creek and operator or owner names. The public record supports the original building and later tenant finish and confirms that the area already includes another data center. No separately bounded State Farm expansion, publicly funded road or utility improvement, quantified strategic benefit, fiber subsidy or State Farm-specific infrastructure reimbursement was located.

research_updates.title: County outcomes and modeling-eligibility audit
research_updates.notes: The repository's official 2001-2024 Johnson County BEA real-GDP and BLS employment/nominal-wage series were reviewed with the 2016 built/lease anchor and the study-county exclusion list. For each outcome, a reproducible last-resort benchmark uses 2008-2015 log level, average log growth and growth volatility, selects the 20 nearest non-study counties, weights them by inverse feature distance and compares 2024 values; twice pre-period RMSE with a five-percentage-point floor defines fit sensitivity. The resulting GDP, employment and wage gaps are retained only as low-confidence descriptive context. No first-county-entry evidence, complete exposure history, validated unexposed controls, placebo, spillover or robustness result supports State Farm attribution. Supplier/community allocations and HPIP credit/net-fiscal models are separately rejected for the metric-specific missing inputs recorded in the candidate table.

source.title: Johnson County economic panel source and design audit
source.publisher: U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis and U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics
source.notes: The repository county panel contains official annual Johnson County real GDP, employment and average-weekly-wage series for 2001-2024. The audit found no registered treatment timing, exposure isolation, uncontaminated control design, pretrend evidence, placebo test or robustness result sufficient to interpret a comparison as a State Farm facility effect; nearby pre-existing data-center activity also prevents an unsupported first-entry assumption.

project_description: State Farm Olathe is a single-tenant data center operated by State Farm Mutual Automobile Insurance Company at 24400 West Valley Parkway in Olathe, Johnson County, Kansas.
